Priya (Partnerships): hey team :wave: quick handoff — VendorX cloud listing needs initial setup across AWS/GCP/Azure. Main open items: legal signoff on entitlements, merchant/publisher roles, staging creds, and final packaging copy. @Ben - Legal can you take the EULA + trial entitlement check? link to prep doc: https://redwood-internal.s3/marketplace/vendorx/entry-playbook.md
Ben - Legal: thanks. can you paste the SKU mapping and intended trial terms here? i want to confirm seat vs usage entitlements before i redline.
Priya (Partnerships): SKU mapping (short):
```
VENDX-CORE-1: 1-seat monthly
VENDX-CORE-5: 5-seat monthly
VENDX-API-100k: usage-based (100k tokens)
Trial: 14-day, single-seat default
```
Marta (Cloud Ops): noted. for staging creds we'll provision in Vault at `secret/marketplace/vendorx/staging`. need Azure publisher ID + AWS account alias to attach. once i get that i'll create staging bundle and a sandbox org.
Samir (Product): packaging note — listing tile should highlight "Dedicated inference support" and "Private deployment (VPC)". also confirm trial UX flow: auto-enable trial on first sign-up, expire after 14 days and send 3 reminder emails.
Priya (Partnerships): @Marta azure publisher ID: 7f12-4bcd. AWS account alias: redwood-marketplace-vendorx. @Ben any EULA blockers on data retention/KMS? we need to publish this week ideally.
Ben - Legal: quick skim — trial entitlement ok but add explicit data retention and KMS clause for private deployments; also require vendor attestation for logs access. i'll drop a redline by EOD.
Priya (Partnerships): perfect. checklist i'm tracking: 1) legal redline, 2) SKU + pricing final, 3) staging creds provisioned, 4) listing assets (logos/screenshots), 5) publishing window scheduling. i'll ping vendor for hi-res logos. :thumbsup:
marketplace-bot: staging-sandbox created for vendorx -> sandbox-345 (credentials pending Vault write)
Marta (Cloud Ops): i'll provision once ben confirms redline doesn't require infra changes. otherwise i can stub creds for testing.
Priya (Partnerships): ok team — i'll consolidate notes and share a short doc with deadlines. tagging follow-ups for tomorrow standup. thanks! :white_check_mark:
